test.create_query: CREATE TABLE object_bulk ( typed JSON(n UInt64, s String), dynamic JSON, wide JSON, shared_one JSON(max_dynamic_paths=0), shared_many JSON(max_dynamic_paths=0), mixed JSON(max_dynamic_paths=1, n UInt64) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.query: SELECT l.number, r.typed FROM numbers(4000000) AS l ANY LEFT JOIN object_bulk AS r ON 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT l.number, r.dynamic FROM numbers(2000000) AS l ANY LEFT JOIN object_bulk AS r ON 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT l.number, r.wide FROM numbers(1000000) AS l ANY LEFT JOIN object_bulk AS r ON 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT l.number, r.shared_one FROM numbers(5000000) AS l ANY LEFT JOIN object_bulk AS r ON 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT l.number, r.shared_many FROM numbers(3000000) AS l ANY LEFT JOIN object_bulk AS r ON 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT l.number, r.mixed FROM numbers(2000000) AS l ANY LEFT JOIN object_bulk AS r ON 1 FORMAT Null
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE object_bulk_arrays (a Array(JSON)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO object_bulk_arrays SELECT arrayMap(x -> ('{{"n":' || toString(x) || ',"s":"repeated"}}')::JSON, range(1024)) FROM numbers(1024)
test.query: SELECT arrayFill(x -> 0, a) FROM object_bulk_arrays FORMAT Null
SELECT arrayReverseFill(x -> 0, a) FROM object_bulk_arrays FORMAT Null
